wellbeing.locksHelp: Kanga fonction moko mpo na poso moko, poso mibale, sanza moko, to mpo na libela.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Zalá mosika na moto oyo azali kopesa yo lisungi to moto oyo akoki kosalisa yo.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Yango ekolongola mpenza bansango na yo mpe ekoki kozongisama te.
safety.wipeConfirm: Namoni ete yango ezali mpenza kolongola bansango na ngai.

reentry.noSteps: Makambo oyo ezali na liste ya makambo oyo esengeli kosala naino te.
reentry.tipsTitle: Toli ya bato oyo basalaki yango
reentry.tipsAnonymous: Moto moko te ayebisaka nkombo ya moto oyo apesi ye yango, ata mpe banimero ya telefone.
reentry.addTip: Kopesa toli na ndenge eyebani te
reentry.celebrationFirst: Likambo ya liboso oyo tosali — toyambami na ndako.
reentry.celebrationAll: Matambe nyonso 33 esalemi. Sepelá ndenge ozali kokende liboso.
reentry.crisisStep: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.resourceOnly: Pointeur ya ressource kaka — Groundwork ezali kopesa yango te to kosala na ba fournisseurs.

sections.legal_and_supervision: Makambo ya mibeko mpe ya kokɛngɛla

steps.step1: Sɛngá mokanda ya kobotama na yo
steps.step2: Sɛngá karte na yo ya sécurité sociale
steps.step3: Bandá application ya ID ya état
steps.step4: Bómityela mikano elongo na mokambi na bino
steps.step5: Bongisá mobembo na yo tii na ndako
steps.step6: Bósala molɔngɔ́ moko mpo na kosunga
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Talelá mikanda na yo ya kobima na bolɔkɔ mpe mikolo ya nsuka
steps.step10: Ndimá mokolo mpe makambo oyo okosala na mbala ya liboso
steps.step12: Zwá mokanda na yo ya Leta
steps.step13: Zwá telefone, e-mail mpe Internet ya ofele
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Sololá na bato oyo basalaka mosala ya kozongisa bato na mboka na bango
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Talá soki ozali na mokanda ya ndingisa ya kokumba motuka
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step21: Salá programɛ ya nkisi oyo okolya
steps.step23: Zwá rendez-vous mpo na maladi ya motó
steps.step24: Luká koyeba soki ozali komɛla bangi to te
steps.step26: Salá liste ya makambo ya bomoi na yo
steps.step27: Luká mosala epai ya bato oyo bazali kopesa yo libaku ya mibale
steps.step29: Fungolá compte na banki mpe bongisá mbongo oyo okobanda kosalela
steps.step30: Bandá kobongisa lisusu mbongo na yo
steps.step31: Zongelá boyokani na libota, mpe soki esengeli, salá ete bana na yo bázwa mbongo ya lisungi
steps.step32: Salá programɛ ya makambo oyo okosala mokolo na mokolo
steps.step33: Mityelá mokano moko oyo okokokisa nsima ya mikolo 90

family.help: Bato ya libota bakomona kaka makambo oyo oponi koyebisa bango.

phase3.resumeHelp: Salelá makambo oyo okutanaki na yango na bomoi na yo mpo na kosala liste ya makambo ya bomoi na yo.
phase3.headline: Motó ya likambo
phase3.interviewHelp: Molakisi na yo akopesa yo lifuti mpe mwa mbongo.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.relapse: Ndenge ya komibatela na maladi yango
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.mentorshipHelp: Luká motambwisi to pesá ye toli.
phase3.geoHelp: Bato mosusu bamonaka kaka engumba oyo ofandi, kasi bayebaka esika oyo ofandi te.
phase3.rideHelp: Sɛngá moto amema yo, komá nimero ya telefone te, bósangana na esika ya bato nyonso.
phase3.partnersHelp: Na mwa bituluku ya bato misato oyo bazali kosolola.
phase3.caption: Maloba ya ebandeli
phase3.qaHelp: Tuná na nkombo te, biyano ekouta epai ya basangani mosusu.
phase3.merchHelp: Ezali kaka na bilembo oyo ekomami na kode, eloko moko te ezali na libándá oyo emonisi ndimbola na yango, mpe dati ezali te.
phase3.shareHelp: Mokanda moko oyo ezali komonisa ete ozali kokende liboso ezali na ntina.
phase3.archiveHelp: Komá mwa mokanda mpo na yo moko, oyo ekofungwama na mokolo moko ya ntina mingi.
phase3.matchHelp: Agent na yo asololi na ba agents mosusu liboso, bokutani ezali te mpo na sikoyo, okoki komona mpo na nini, botika koboya, mpe bosala lisano ya sika.
phase3.datingOff: Tokobanda kobima na bato te tii ntango tokotya mobeko ya mikolo oyo esengeli.
phase3.carpoolTitle: Lisangá ya bato oyo bakendaka na motuka
phase3.carpoolHelp: Esika ya liboso ya kotala. Option-in, na niveau ya engumba kaka: tala nani azali kokende na likita na yo mpe kangama na nzela ya ba messages ya kati ya application. sans numéros de téléphone, sans position précise.
phase3.carpoolJoin: Komá ngai na kati ya etuluku
phase3.carpoolMatches: Bato bazali koya na nzela oyo
phase3.groupsHelp: Bituluku ya kozonga na bomoi, bituluku ya lisungi ya kozonga na bomoi, mpe mangomba mpe bituluku ya bato ya mboka na engumba mpe ngonga ya makita.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Emonisami kaka soki moto moko te na mesaje ya kokabola motuka azali kokende na likita na yo.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Mpo na likita yango, moto moko te azali na motuka oyo ekokani na oyo ya ye, yango wana "Azali na mposa ya motuka" ezali na esika ya mibale.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Kaka basofɛlɛ oyo bazwi ndingisa. Ba ping ekendaka moko na moko na ngonga ya miniti mibale; okondima liboso ya kokutana na moto oyo akoya nsima.
phase3.pingConfirm: Kondimisa liboso ya kobenga na nsima
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.calcResult: mwa basanza liboso okokisa mokano na yo
phase3.planTitle: Plan ya komibongisa mpo na ndako
phase3.musicHelp: Ezali kaka na banzembo ya ndakisa, ezali na ba-accounts te, mpe batyaka yango na kati ya ba-module ya kelasi.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Miziki ezali te ntango ozali koyekola.
phase3.shareWho: Sikoyo: kaka yo. Kotya molɔngɔ́ ya makambo ekoki kopesa moto nyonso oyo azali na molɔngɔ́ ya makambo likoki ya kotánga yango.
phase3.suggestTitle: Makambo oyo osalaki na bomoi na yo
phase3.suggestHelp: Makanisi kaka — eloko moko ebimisami te kino okotisa yango.
